text: RESOLVED: Sigma[U] stays in frame units; Sigma.deg is the documented default path. Rationale: forcing degrees would require a Viewing for every KDE, making eyes4s unusable on any dataset without known viewing geometry -- all web-based collection and most shared datasets. The unit parameter already makes smoothing a Px grid with a Sigma[Deg] a compile error, so generality costs no safety. Affects k-sigma, s-smoother, s-bandwidth.
